title: Plugins
description: Plugins give agents skills and MCP servers, from directories under ~/.eta/plugins/ or from git. One must be configured before it can be enabled. Its configuration is global; each agent chooses which plugins to use.

empty.title: No plugins yet
empty.description: Put a plugin in ~/.eta/plugins/<name>/, or add one from a git repository.

skipped: {{agents}} enabled this, but its configuration no longer fits. It is skipped until that is fixed.

add.title: Add a plugin from git
add.description: It is resolved to one commit and stays there until you update it.
add.rev: Branch, tag or commit (HEAD by default)
add.path: Path inside the repository (root by default)

remove.confirmDescription: Its fetched files are deleted. Its configuration and PLUGIN_DATA stay, for when it is added again.

configure.title: Configure {{name}}
configure.description: Fill in the fields this plugin declares. These values go to its MCP servers.
configure.secretKept: Saved. Leave blank to keep it
configure.incomplete: Something required is missing: it will still need configuring.
configure.savedReady: Saved. The plugin can be enabled
configure.encryptionHelp: The configuration is stored encrypted on the host, and secrets are not shown again.

servers.title: Runs
servers.etaNote: These servers start for agents on an external runtime. eta's own loop does not support MCP yet.

issue.pattern: Does not match the required format
